title: 第21章 好聚好散第22章 你要是走了这手术我就不做了
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
苏灿听的眼睛一亮，赶紧冲不远处的周青山招了下手，爷俩跟著一起去了后院。
一到后院，周大爷便看到了自己的马车，刚刚还颓丧的脸顿时有了笑意。
“是我的马车！是我们家的马车！”
周青山也跟著鬆了口气。
在农村，这可是家里的大件。
要是丟了那可真跟要了大爷的命一样。
苏灿看到周大爷上前拍著马背，忍不住笑起来。
没丟，真好。
“青山，我得赶紧回去了，你东哥这么长时间看不到我们肯定会担心的。”
自己这一趟出去回来，怎么也得半个小时了，陆战东不著急才怪。
“嫂子，我跟你一起上去。”
院子里这么多当兵的，周青山不放心苏灿一个人上楼。
“行。”
两个人从后门进了一楼大厅，顺著楼梯往上走。
沿路看到隔一段距离便有人站岗，而且苏灿一眼便看出来了，全都是荷枪实弹。
看这个样子，医院里是来了大人物。
两人到了三楼的病房，进去一看，直接愣住了。
床上哪还有陆战东的影子？
已经住上其他人了。
苏灿赶紧询问同房间的病人家属，结果对方的回答让她有些懵。

“你家那口子不是去手术室了吗？”
“啊？这还不到时间呀，十点才开始动手术，还有一个多小时呢。”
病房里的人表示无奈，苏灿找了找柜子，发现自己带来的水壶和包全都不见了。
她顿时著急了，要知道陆战东的名章和军官证可全都在里面呢。
苏灿著急的出了病房，正准备去找护士问问，被刚才在楼下的那个排长拦住了去路。
“这位同志，请问您是不是陆战东的妻子苏灿？”
苏灿点了下头：“是的，不会是你们把人给转走的吧？他犯什么错误了吗？”
猛然想到陆战东也是军人，现在医院里又来了这么多当兵的，会不会跟陆战东有关？
“您放心，陆团长他没有犯错误。只是给他转到了更好的病房，您请跟我来。”
听他这么说，苏灿稍稍放了心。
跟著赵铁柱走到了走廊的尽头，一拐过弯去就看到了两张熟悉的面孔。
苏灿顿时皱了下眉，她就是带陆战东来治腿伤，想不到在这里也能遇到姜玉容和杨雅丽。
“好呀，你个苏灿，我说你拿著钱跑到哪儿去了，家里翻天覆地的找你，竟然拿著钱跑去找你妹夫了。还骗他说，你要替雅丽嫁给她！你说我怎么生了你这么个忘恩负义的女儿？”
一看到苏灿出现，姜玉容先下手为强，上去对著苏灿一顿指责。
“姐，你怎么能这样？我平常好吃的全都给你留著，你怎么能打著我的名义去桃村呢？我知道你因为胖一向自卑，但是你也不能报復在我头上呀。”
杨雅丽边说边哭的泪如雨下，不知道的还以为苏灿对她做了什么伤天害理的事呢。
苏灿看著眼前这两个女人精湛的演技，呵呵冷笑一声。
“我说，你俩这是给我唱的哪一出？”
她多少看明白了，杨雅丽不知从哪儿知道了陆战东送到医院的消息，发现他的腿能治好，所以后悔让她替嫁了。
姜玉容气愤地指著她：“你还好意思问我们，你自己偷了家里的三百块钱，跑到桃村告诉自己的妹夫，说你妹妹雅丽不想嫁给他了，让你代替她嫁过去。今天要不是跟著方局长过来，我们还不知道你编了这么大的谎言！”
content_en:
Su Can's eyes lit up when he heard this, and he quickly waved to Zhou Qingshan who was not far away. The two of them followed him to the backyard.
As soon as he arrived in the backyard, Uncle Zhou saw his carriage, and a smile suddenly appeared on his face that had been depressed just now.
"It's my carriage! It's our family's carriage!"
Zhou Qingshan also breathed a sigh of relief.
In rural areas, this is a big item in the family.
If it were lost, it would be like killing the uncle.
Su Can couldn't help laughing when he saw Uncle Zhou stepping forward to pat the horse's back.
It’s not lost, that’s great.
"Qingshan, I have to go back quickly. Your brother Dong will definitely be worried if he can't see us for so long."
It would take him half an hour to come back from his trip. It would be strange for Lu Zhandong not to be in a hurry.
"Sister-in-law, I'll go up with you."
There were so many soldiers in the yard, and Zhou Qingshan was worried that Su Can would go upstairs alone.
"Okay."
The two people entered the hall on the first floor through the back door and walked up the stairs.
Along the road, I saw people standing guard at some distance, and Su Can could tell at a glance that they were all armed with live ammunition.
From the looks of it, a big shot is coming to the hospital.
The two of them arrived at the ward on the third floor. When they went in and took a look, they were stunned.
Where is the shadow of Lu Zhandong on the bed?
Others are already living there.
Su Can quickly asked the patient's family members in the same room, but the other party's answer made her a little confused.
"Didn't your wife go to the operating room?"
"Ah? It's not enough time. The operation won't start until ten o'clock, so there's still more than an hour left."
People in the ward expressed helplessness. Su Can looked in the cabinet and found that all the water bottles and bags he brought were missing.
She suddenly became anxious, knowing that Lu Zhandong's name badge and military officer's ID were all inside.
Su Can anxiously left the ward and was about to go to the nurse to ask, but was blocked by the platoon leader who was downstairs just now.
"Comrade, are you Lu Zhandong's wife Su Can?"
Su Can nodded: "Yes, it wasn't you who transferred the person away, was it? Did he make any mistakes?"
It suddenly occurred to me that Lu Zhandong is also a soldier. Now there are so many soldiers in the hospital. Could it be related to Lu Zhandong?
"Don't worry, Commander Lu made no mistake. He was just transferred to a better ward. Please follow me."
Hearing what he said, Su Can felt relieved a little.
Following Zhao Tiezhu to the end of the corridor, he saw two familiar faces when he turned the corner.
Su Can frowned immediately. She just brought Lu Zhandong here to treat his leg injury. She didn't expect to meet Jiang Yurong and Yang Yali here.
"Okay, you Su Can, where did you go with the money? The family is looking for you, but you actually took the money and ran to your brother-in-law. You even lied to him that you wanted to marry Yali for her! Why do you think I gave birth to such an ungrateful daughter like you?"
As soon as he saw Su Can appear, Jiang Yurong acted first and went up to accuse Su Can.
"Sister, how could you do this? I usually save all the delicious food for you, how could you go to Taocun in my name? I know you have always felt inferior because of your fatness, but you can't take revenge on me."
Yang Yali cried like rain while talking, and she didn't know that Su Can had done something evil to her.
Su Can looked at the superb acting skills of the two women in front of him and sneered.
"I said, which song are you two singing for me?"
She more or less understood that Yang Yali somehow found out that Lu Zhandong was sent to the hospital and found out that his leg could be cured, so she regretted letting her marry him as a substitute.
Jiang Yurong pointed at her angrily: "You still have the nerve to ask us. You stole three hundred yuan from home and went to Taocun to tell your brother-in-law that your sister Yali didn't want to marry him and asked you to marry her instead. If you hadn't followed Director Fang here today, we wouldn't have known you had made up such a big lie!"
